description: Voltage controlled quad crossover: one signal split into four frequency bands, each with a send and a return.

params.text: Sets the crossover between the LO and MID-LO bands, within a 15Hz to 8400Hz range, and stops where the next crossover up is set.
Sets the crossover between the MID-LO and MID-HI bands, within a 15Hz to 8400Hz range, and stays between the other two crossovers.
Sets the crossover between the MID-HI and HI bands, within a 15Hz to 8400Hz range, and stops where the next crossover down is set.
Scales the CV for the crossover it belongs to, from -100% to +100%; at full, 10V moves that crossover across its whole range.

inputs.text: The signal that gets split into the four bands.
Moves the crossover frequency it belongs to, scaled by the small attenuverter for that crossover.
Brings a processed band back into the mix; with nothing patched, that band reaches the mix unprocessed.

outputs.text: One band of the input, filtered out with a two-pole slope, for processing outside the module.
The four bands summed and halved.

notes: each band's return is normalled to that band's send, so the mix output carries all four bands whether or not anything is patched into the returns.
